name: Customer Support Escalation
description: Move difficult support cases from triage through reproducibility, bounded resolution, engineering escalation, customer communication, and systemic learning.

tasks.name: Triage the case
tasks.objective: Capture customer objective, exact symptom, impact and severity, environment or account context, attempted fixes, evidence, entitlement or SLA, security and privacy flags, and whether the issue is isolated or systemic.

tasks.name: Reproduce or bound the failure
tasks.objective: Use safe diagnostic steps, logs, known-issue search, account or configuration comparison, and minimal reproduction. Do not ask the customer to repeat steps already evidenced.

tasks.name: Attempt frontline resolution
tasks.objective: Apply documented reversible fixes within support authority, verify outcome with the customer or telemetry, and record what changed.

tasks.name: Build an escalation package
tasks.objective: When unresolved, send engineering or operations the smallest complete package: impact, priority rationale, reproduction, timestamps, identifiers, logs or screenshots, expected and actual behavior, workarounds, and what has already been ruled out.

tasks.name: Maintain customer communication
tasks.objective: Give honest status, ownership, workaround or risk, and next update time. Do not translate internal uncertainty into fake ETAs or make the customer poll for progress.

tasks.name: Verify and close
tasks.objective: Confirm the fix in the affected environment, distinguish temporary workaround from permanent resolution, document root cause when appropriate, and update knowledge or known-issue material.

tasks.name: Feed systemic learning
tasks.objective: Aggregate repeated escalations into product defects, documentation gaps, alerting needs, training issues, and workflow changes with owners and measurable follow-through.
